about: Each fixture's pixels as Pillow 12.2 decodes them (converted to RGBA, then sha256 of the bytes), recorded 2026-10-19 so the score's own PNG reader is checked against an independent decoder on files it did not write (claude-config#1364). chrome-rgb.png is a real headless Chrome 154 screenshot, 8 bit RGB using the Sub, Up and Paeth filters; the other two are Pillow's own palette and grey with alpha files made from it.
